messages:
Alex: Heads up — ran into weird SSE behavior in prod where a 'soft' quota timeout interrupts the stream mid-chunk and clients get a bogus final event ordering. Repro steps below.

Maria: Ugh. Is this the quota soft-limit that adds a header then lets the connection finish, or the hard cutoff that closes immediately?

Alex: Soft quota. Our proxy sends `X-Quota-Soft: 1` then downstream enforcer starts dropping tokens after 100ms grace. Client sees: data chunk, data chunk, "event: done" then suddenly a reconnect/resume token, which makes some clients replay last token and double-count.

Kevin: Do you have the raw bytes/logs? can you paste a curl capture?

Alex: Sure — curl --raw output:```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
X-Quota-Soft: 1

data: {"id":"tok1","text":"hello"}

data: {"id":"tok2","text":"world"}
event: done

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
X-Resume-Token: rtk:abc123

data: {"id":"tok3","text":"after-resume"}
```

Maria: That ordering is the issue — we shouldn't produce a new 200/resume stream after sending `event: done`. Clients interpret that as a new logical response.

Jorge: Where is the resume token being inserted? at the proxy layer or the runtime?

Alex: Currently proxy sets resume token on reconnect path when request gets routed to fallback model due to quota enforcement. So proxy triggers reconnect, runtime opens a new stream and runtime emits the token header. But the original stream already emitted `done` event because the enforcer dropped tail tokens.

Priya: This explains double-billing reports from two customers — client replays resume and we reprocess last N tokens. Also our trace IDs show two separate request IDs around the same timeframe.

Kevin: Two quick ideas: 1) make proxy wait for client to close before opening a resume stream (adds latency) 2) change semantics so `event: done` is only emitted by runtime after resume header decision is final. Which is less risky?

Maria: Option 2 seems safer UX-wise — runtime can emit a `paused` event instead of `done` when quota soft is in play, and proxy can later emit `done` if it's final. Need to verify SSE client compatibility with `paused`.

Jorge: Plus telemetry — we should tag streams that saw X-Quota-Soft and whether they later resumed. Add counters: quota.soft_seen, quota.resume_attempted, quota.resume_success.

Priya: Also need a console UX point: rollout a toggle to keep old behavior for a day per region so we can measure double-billing delta. Add a per-tenant flag behind Dedicated/Private opt-in.

Alex: Repro checklist I ran: 1) run model that streams heavy tokens 2) send request that hits soft_quota_threshold 3) observe `done` then new 200 with X-Resume-Token. Happened in us-west-2 via proxy A only.

Kevin: Can we add a short server-side grace period where runtime buffers the final 200ms of output and blocks sending `done` until proxy decides? That avoids new stream races. Buffer size small.

Maria: Buffering could add 200ms tail latency. For chat apps that expect low latency that might be noticeable. But it's bounded and optional behind flag.

Jorge: Implementation plan: runtime introduces STATE_PAUSED; when quota soft seen, emit `event: paused` and keep connection open for 250ms window. Proxy signals `resume` or `finalize` via a control frame or header on reconnect. If finalize -> runtime converts paused->done and closes. If resume -> runtime sends resume token metadata and continues.

Priya: For older clients that don't handle `paused`, will they break? Most just treat as unknown event types and ignore, so OK. Need a short compatibility note in migration docs.

Kevin: Telemetry: add a new tracing span `sse.soft_quota_handoff` and a boolean tag `handed_off_to_proxy`. Also emit a histogram of pause_window_ms.

Alex: QA steps: simulate quota soft with local proxy, test client libraries (JS/browser SSE + python requests + iOS ws) for ordering, ensure no duplicate tokens processed.

ops-bot: @channel Deployment checklist created: rollout/quota-soft-fix, canary in us-west-2 only.

deploy-bot: Canary started: rollout/quota-soft-fix -> 5% of traffic in us-west-2 at 12:20 UTC. Monitor `quota.resume_success` and `billing.duplicate_events` for 30m.

Maria: One more edge: cross-region sticky routing — if proxy A sends paused and client reconnects to proxy B which lacks context, B might issue a resume token and duplicate again. Need cluster-level sticky metadata or resume token signing that encodes seen-offset.

Jorge: Signed resume tokens is good. Include stream-id + offset + HMAC so any proxy or runtime can verify and dedupe. Also include ttl to prevent long-lived replays.

Priya: I'll draft docs for console feature flag and add a small dashboard: "SSE soft-quota handoffs" with churn rate and duplicate-event ratio. Include alert if duplicate_event_rate > 0.1% for 15m.

Kevin: Action items: Alex — prototype runtime paused state + buffer. Jorge — resume token signing spec. Priya — dashboard + console flag. Maria — compatibility note + libs QA. Meet in 30 to sync.

Alex: On it. Starting a local prototype now, will post a short gank with logs when ready. :thumbsup:
